fusions.name: Ripe Puffballs
fusions.desc: Seeds up to 3 bodies within 9 tiles with puffballs for 30 seconds. Each one bursts the moment an enemy comes within 2 tiles of it and deals 26 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Settling Spores
fusions.desc: Puffs a cloud of stinkhorn spores at the first enemy within 6 tiles that deals 3 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stink-Cap Stand
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to plant a stand of stinkhorns beside you for 12 seconds. They shed spores on an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds, each time with a 35% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Body
fusions.desc: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, a puff of spores hits the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
